actual_client_pending_matches_each_fixed.interpretation: False because eight planned waves were unexecuted; all 24 executed waves record the required distinct pending count.

all_controller_custody_and_fixture_proof.interpretation: The frozen gate also requires every controller status=complete. Controller 3 failed setup; all four owned children were nevertheless reaped and all four fixture-after-shutdown digests match their initial digests.

all_host_gates_clear.interpretation: Top-level aggregation field absent after the failed block; both blocks retain clear before/after host receipts, and three controllers that reached measurement retain clear premeasurement host receipts.

all_qualified_inputs_unchanged.interpretation: Top-level aggregation field absent. Both per-block bundle/source fences passed; the final global frozen-input receipt sweep after all successful blocks was not reached.

baseline_c1_8_correct_for_cpu_attributio.interpretation: Only 4/8 planned baseline C1 calls ran; controller 3 stopped at warmup.

c1_cpu_per_attempt_le_1_10.interpretation: Undefined (null ratio), not passed: baseline C1 CPU has no complete two-controller endpoints.

c1_wall_per_attempt_le_1_10.interpretation: Raw true for unequal observed populations (candidate 8 versus baseline 4 attempts); not an admissible complete ABBA improvement.

c4_inclusive_cpu_per_attempt_le_1_10.interpretation: Undefined (null ratio), not passed: baseline C4 CPU has no complete two-controller endpoints.

c4_inclusive_cpu_per_success_le_1_10.interpretation: Undefined (null ratio), not passed: baseline C4 CPU has no complete two-controller endpoints.

c4_successful_calls_per_second_ge_1_50.interpretation: Raw true for 32 candidate versus 16 baseline attempts; incomplete comparison, not an admissible speedup.

candidate_c1_8_correct.interpretation: Eight of eight candidate C1 calls succeeded.

candidate_c4_32_correct.interpretation: Thirty of 32 candidate C4 calls succeeded; two genuine total-deadline product failures.

candidate_c4_successes_not_lower.interpretation: Raw true (30 versus 4 successes), with half the planned baseline C4 inventory unexecuted; insufficient for adoption.

complete_fixed_inventory.interpretation: 60/80 attempts and 24/32 waves executed; slots 60..79 and all controller-3 waves remain explicitly unexecuted.

no_observed_controller_children_or_reape.interpretation: False because controller 3 has no measured endpoints; all nine existing endpoints show empty owned-thread child lists and zero child CPU ticks.

wholelife_max_rss_regression_guard.interpretation: Observed candidate wait4 peak 114688 KiB exceeds recorded limit 113251.6 KiB. All four wait4 receipts exist, but baseline controller 3 never measured; no completed balanced-ABBA memory result.
